name: Total Plastics, Int’l
old_description: Total Plastics is your go-to plastics distributor in the Northeastern U.S., stocking acrylic / plexiglass sheets, Lexan® polycarbonate panels, engineered plastic rods, tubes, films and more.Beyond reliable plastics distribution, we offer precision value-added machining and custom fabrication services to meet your exact specifications.
about:
Total Plastics, Int'l was founded in 1978 by John Kozacki and Jerome Kollig in Kalamazoo, Michigan. The company began as a plastics warehouse and expanded to a national sales office in Grand Rapids, Michigan by 1984. Today it is headquartered in Renton, Washington, and operates a network of 15 locations across the United States.

The company stocks thousands of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films — including acrylic, polycarbonate, PEEK, PTFE, UHMW, and HDPE — and backs its inventory with precision CNC machining, laser cutting, waterjet cutting, thermoforming, and custom fabrication. Its services range from cut-to-size sheet fabrication and multi-axis CNC routing to turning, milling, welding, bonding, and full assembly. The firm says it handles everything from one-off prototypes to high-volume production runs, with tolerances as tight as ±0.005 inch.

Total Plastics serves aerospace, automotive, architecture and construction, medical and life sciences, marine, electronics and electrical, signage and graphics, and general manufacturing. Customers include aircraft interior manufacturers, medical device makers, boat builders, and retail display fabricators.

The company emphasizes its logistical reach — 15 U.S. locations with worldwide shipping — and its in-house material testing and dimensional inspection labs as differentiators. It also highlights rapid quoting, with most quotes returned within 24 hours.
